issue.body:
This PR does the following things:

- Backs out our custom --no-jlinking fix for 23.1 (https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/commit/588ae3a38d6d047ae30277f5fdd3e26d3cefada4)
- Adds a backport of https://github.com/oracle/graal/pull/7454 (modulo the changelog entry commit of https://github.com/oracle/graal/pull/7454/commits/5f35fcaf3f850fa43f0adeb4ad6c18a6c895f106), which is a pre-requisite change
- Adds a backport of https://github.com/oracle/graal/pull/7205 (all of them simple cherry-picks).

This now removes the old agent-based native image build in our 23.1.2 release, but it should be OK because it's unlikely any quarkus user is using it. It's a needed change in order to not drag in some ByteBuffer classes into the image heap when generating the native image agent.

issue.title: JDK-8316304 in JDK 21 introduced a new field accessed through JNI
issue.body:
Similar fix to `main` which was done in
https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/37813 for jpa-postgresql and in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/37879 for jpa-postgresql-withxml.

Openning as draft till tests with mandrel 23.1 and JDK 21.0.1+12 build complete in https://github.com/graalvm/mandrel/actions/runs/7461888676

cc @jerboaa

body:
The failures at hand are related to either:

a) a failure in another test, e.g. in `io.quarkus.it.main.ImageMetricsITCase#verifyImageMetrics`
b) a test abort due to a failing assumption, e.g. in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/21f055a531ec2828c5224e304fc0b4cc8f3707fb/test-framework/junit5/src/main/java/io/quarkus/test/junit/nativeimage/NativeBuildOutputExtension.java#L54

This happens because test failures are recorded in the test's extension context through `io.quarkus.test.junit.AbstractQuarkusTestWithContextExtension` and are then seen by `io.quarkus.it.main.QuarkusTestCallbacksITCase#testCallbackContextIsNotFailed` which checks to see the test status of the context in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/1ed54f025198d4ef728b38fe7fe6f880518b1592/integration-tests/main/src/test/java/io/quarkus/it/main/QuarkusTestCallbacksITCase.java#L61

> I guess the callback test is only interested in failures caused in its test class, no?

exactly

issue.title: Don't fail testCallBackContextIsNotFailed on aborted tests
issue.body:
As seen in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/37809 `testCallBackContextIsNotFailed` fails when other tests get aborted due to a failing assumption, e.g. in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/21f055a531ec2828c5224e304fc0b4cc8f3707fb/test-framework/junit5/src/main/java/io/quarkus/test/junit/nativeimage/NativeBuildOutputExtension.java#L54

This happens because test failures are recorded in the test's extension context through `io.quarkus.test.junit.AbstractQuarkusTestWithContextExtension` and are then seen by `io.quarkus.it.main.QuarkusTestCallbacksITCase#testCallbackContextIsNotFailed` which checks to see the test status of the context in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/1ed54f025198d4ef728b38fe7fe6f880518b1592/integration-tests/main/src/test/java/io/quarkus/it/main/QuarkusTestCallbacksITCase.java#L61

This is a naive fix that doesn't treat `TestAbortedException`s as failures for the said test.
